title: Changelog hero + inline hover-state snapshot pack for compact quickstart tiles
creator: Ava Patel
description:
Summary: Produce a compact image pack for the March changelog and release blog that highlights hero comparison visuals (before/after UI), micro-interaction hover states, and a set of inline quickstart tiles intended for documentation and marketing embedding. Goal is to ship a lightweight set of 8 export-ready PNG/SVG assets plus a gif micro-interaction set suitable for web embedding and the docs quickstart.

Deliverables:
- 3 hero comparison frames (wide, 16:9) showing before / after UI with callout pins for the main UX changes
- 4 compact quickstart tiles (600x400 px) showing stepwise onboarding screenshots and an alternate compact layout for mobile docs
- 1 hover-state GIF (looping) demonstrating hover reveal and tooltip microcopy for the new row-actions in the Console changelog table
- Export pack with layered .svg, flattened .png at 2x, WebP preview, and a README with usage guidelines and alt-text suggestions

Design decisions & trade-offs:
- Chose compact tile aspect (3:2) to match docs grid constraints instead of full-bleed hero to keep file sizes small; this prioritizes clarity in inline docs over dramatic hero treatments.
- Used a muted, high-contrast callout color (Redwood teal #0A97A6) for pins to remain accessible against both light/dark console themes; tested at 3:1 contrast against background.
- Avoided heavy drop-shadows to reduce noise in small tiles; instead used subtle outline and focus halo for state emphasis.

Progress updates (chronological):

- 2026-03-05 Marco: Initial Figma frames created (v0.1) with layout variants: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd1234/Changelog-Visuals-March-2026
- 2026-03-08 Design review with PM (Lena Ortiz) and Eng lead (Priya Nair). Feedback: reduce text density on compact tiles; include alt-text and accessible labels.
- 2026-03-10 Marco: v0.2 with hover-state micro-interaction prototype (120ms reveal, 300ms easing). Pushed sample exports to drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1ExamplePackLink
- 2026-03-12 PM review: Approved hero comparison framing; asked for one variant with annotation callout numbers instead of pins for blog SEO.
- 2026-03-14 QA: Size optimization pass complete; final GIF loop reduced to 450KB using LZW palette reduction.

Review feedback & action items:
- PM (Lena Ortiz): "Hero comparison is clear; please add a caption variation that calls out latency/cost numbers for the release blog header." ACTION: add caption overlay variant (estimate +1 point).
- Eng (Priya Nair): "Ensure pixel-perfect alignment with Console release branch — I linked a branch with latest UI tweaks (github.com/redwood/console#feature/changelog-table)." ACTION: verify screenshots on dev build before final export.
- Accessibility (Noah Kim): "Confirm alt-text strings and ARIA-friendly captions delivered in README." ACTION: include alt-text for each export and text-only caption file for screen readers.

Acceptance criteria (for QA sign-off):
- All 8 assets exported at 2x resolution, with compressed web-friendly copies and a README that includes usage, alt-text, and suggested captions.
- Hero frames show consistent pin numbering and callout labels; blog variant includes caption overlay with release stats.
- GIF micro-interaction demonstrates hover reveal without layout jitter and remains under 600KB.
- PM sign-off on visual language and Eng confirmation of pixel accuracy against dev build.

Notes & miscellaneous:

- Avoid embedding product data in visuals; use mocked telemetry numbers with note in README.
- Suggested README section: "Which asset to choose" mapping to blog header, in-doc inline, mobile quickstart, and social preview.
